about: Fresh holdout set, written 6 Nov 2026 after all prompt and rule tuning was finished. Labels were fixed before the first run. Prompts and rules were NOT changed after seeing these results. Situations are paraphrased from discovery-engine posts (no raw text, names or personal data) plus new wordings.
